name: Improvised Food Weaponry
body:
You are able to use edibles as deadly weapons.

Prerequisites(s): 1st-level culinarian, Craft (culinary) 5 ranks, or Profession (cook) 5 ranks.

Benefit(s): You gain the benefits of Catch Off-Guard, Throw Anything, and Improvisational Focus, but only when using food items as weapons. You could, for example, wield a ham as a club, a string of sausages as a nunchaku or a whip, or throw chicken wings as shuriken (dealing bludgeoning damage). This feat counts as the indicated feats for all prerequisites, but only for edible weapons. Raw food can still be cooked and eaten after being used as a weapon, but cooked food becomes spoiled and inedible if used in a fight.
